text:
maria_finance: Heads-up — new procurement window & automated approvals rolling out Monday 2026-04-06. Small purchase rules changed: purchases <= $2,000 can be auto-approved if they match an existing vendor category and cost center. See the quick checklist below and the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/procurement/2026-small-purchase-flow :sparkles:

kevin_eng: Quick q — how does this affect recurring subscriptions (monthly SaaS) under $2k/year?

maria_finance: Good question. Recurring subscriptions count toward annual spend. If projected annualized cost stays <= $2k and you use the approved vendor list, it qualifies for auto-approval. If projected > $2k, submit a regular vendor approval.

olivia_product: Do we need separate approvals for Dedicated contracts vs hosted SaaS? Example: Datadog infra vs Datadog onboarding service.

maria_finance: Policy is based on vendor + spend category, not product SKU. If one vendor covers both, combine under one vendor approval. Dedicated/commitment language should be included in the approval notes so we can flag for finance negotiations.

procurement-bot: :robot_face: New automated route enabled — "small-purchase-auto-approve". Submit here: https://redwood.internal/forms/purchase-request. Auto-approve criteria: vendor in approved list, cost <= 2000, cost center present, invoice terms standard.

jules_ops: For pre-approved legacy spend (contracts signed in 2025), do we need retroactive entries? I have a few vendor invoices that fell through the cracks.

maria_finance: Please file a retroactive exception using the form and tag me. We can backfill up to 6 months; anything older will need manager + finance director sign-off. Use code block with invoice meta: 

```
vendor: Acme Tools
invoice_date: 2025-11-04
amount: 1,350
cost_center: ENG-OPS-01
reason: missed onboarding
```

maria_finance: Also small note on virtual cards — new default GL mapping is `GL: 5410_SaaS` for SaaS under $2k, and `GL: 5425_Tools` for infra tooling. Please do not change GL on single-use cards unless instructed.

kevin_eng: ack, will update our onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:

olivia_product: timeline ok. Where can I find the approved vendor list?

maria_finance: Approved vendor list is here: https://redwood.internal/finance/vendors (read-only). If you need a vendor added, request via the form and include a short security review link. Target SLA for vendor additions is 5 biz days.

maria_finance: TL;DR: starting 2026-04-06: auto-approvals for <= $2k with constraints; recurring subscriptions annualized; retroactive exceptions up to 6 months; vendor-add SLA 5 days. Ping me for edge cases. :handshake:
